title: Counter-USV Adversarial Robustness — derived data & results
description: Weight-free derived annotations, track/behavior/defense features, and evaluation freezes for the Counter-USV adversarial robustness project. Companion to the GitHub code repository. Paper figures, model weights, and patch-bank tensors are withheld.

creators.affiliation: Autonomous Systems Engineering Lab (ASEL), Duke University
